Dear Miss Yonge
The colonial conscience exists as you see in relation to [copyright.](../others.html#172) If you will kindly sign the enclosed receipt we will be able to recover for you munificent sum of 11/8d. for the wrong done you by the sale of Yankee reprints in British territory.
[I](../persons.html#939) am not going to America after all, & will, I trust have the pleasure of seeing you at my house when you come to London.

Will you kindly give me as long notice as you can. I am going for a holiday, but could regulate it as to time.

Yours ever faithfully
Alex Macmillan
